definition.notice_criterion: The decision words this three ways: "a notice folded since 2026-10-18 20:30Z" (point 4, amendment B5), "the tender ids of every notice ingested since 2026-10-18 20:30Z" (synthesis) and "notices folded since 2627, not ingested_at (notices fetched before the cutoff but parsed later fall through)" (C3). Wider reading taken: first folded (parsed and folded for the first time) since the EARLIER cutoff 2026-10-18T20:30:00Z. Re-folds of already-folded notices are not counted (2627, 2630 and the zero-drift probe re-folded every notice of the 3,502, which would make the criterion vacuous). On the public API the only per-notice instant is ingested_at; it is assigned at insert in id order, so the probes binary-searched the boundary over the 15,537 named notices: the newest named notice, 47406725, was ingested 2026-10-16T07:35:45Z, before the cutoff, so no named notice was ingested since it. A notice ingested earlier but first parsed later (a quarantine reclaim or a re-parse keeps its ingested_at) is not visible per notice without a detail GET of each; no reclaim or re-parse job is on record in the window (the daily chain does not reclaim), and such a fold that moved facts, rounds, groups, closure or value writes a tender change row (canonical.rs append_version_changes), which (a) reads; only a silent (projection-only) version would escape. Recorded as a residual.
operative: (a) an id of the 3,502 with a `tender` change row in GET /v1/changes after cursor 958787061 (the end of project 2627) whose changed_at is at or before that id's own fetch time (its b6 sidecar fetched_at; a second-precision sidecar is read as the end of its second), EXCLUDING the 3,502 rows of the switch-off drain-back 2630 (cursor (958787061, 958809778]);

(b) OR an id whose fetched Tender names (version caused_by, lot_results/bids/contracts notice_id; the port's version_notice_ids) a notice folded since 2026-10-18T20:30:00Z, read as: its ingested_at is at or after 2026-10-18T20:30:00Z (the wider reading, see notice_criterion);
(c) unioned with 571's set (b6/l_changed_571_ids.json), 545's set (b6/l_changed_545_ids.json) and 541's 2632 corrections (the tender rows in cursor (958809778, 958809905]).
definition.why_2630_is_excluded: Read literally, criterion (a) puts every one of the 3,502 in L_changed: project 2630 (2026-10-19 03:34-03:36Z, refold-lot-sum by the 3,502 at W=false) wrote one version-null `changed` row for each of exactly the 3,502, after 958787061 and before every fetch, so the parity would compare nothing. Those rows are path W's own drain-back (each served head going from lot-sum-awards back to its max election; issue 551 "B5 -- switched off and drained back"), not a change of any fact the port reads: the decision excludes them itself where it builds the complement ("minus 2630's own correction rows") and lists the post-2627 fact changes as 541, the daily chains and 571 only. The one code change 2630 carried besides W=false is 541 unit 2 (923172d: T02 MOVE awards write a RES-T02), inert on the 3,502: none of their 15,537 notices is a T02 or carries TED-COST_PARAMETERS (one T01 prior-information notice, 18002514 on 5278856, which 541 does not read). The literal reading is recorded in literal_reading.

literal_reading.note: criterion (a) without the 2630 exclusion: every id of the 3,502 (via its 2630 row)
